_comment: How villagers come to the barangay (engine/population.ts): births, and the reasons newcomers arrive, each with a Balita line in English and Filipino. weight: how often the reason is picked; needs: when it can happen at all (alliance: a marriage alliance or sandugo with a neighbor; marriage: a marriage alliance; trade: a trade has been made; allyRaided: an ally was raided in the last two Araw); boost: an extra weight while `needs` holds; size: how many come together (at most rules.population.familyMax, and only while there is room); spouse: the newcomer marries a single villager. Placeholders: {names} the newcomers, {name} the first, {spouse} who they married, {barangay} where they came from, {mother} and {father} the parents of a newborn, {child} the newborn.

birth.en: A child was born to {mother} and {father}: {child}.
birth.fil: Isinilang ang anak nina {mother} at {father}: si {child}.

text.en: {names} came from upriver looking for land to farm.
text.fil: Dumating mula sa itaas ng ilog si {names} upang maghanap ng lupang masasaka.
Dumating si {name} mula sa {barangay} upang pakasalan si {spouse}.

text.en: A family from {barangay} joined the barangay through the alliance: {names}.
text.fil: Sumama sa barangay ang isang pamilya mula sa {barangay} dahil sa alyansa: {names}.

text.en: {name}, a trader from {barangay}, decided to stay.
text.fil: Nagpasyang manatili si {name}, isang mangangalakal mula sa {barangay}.

text.en: Kin from raided {barangay} came seeking shelter: {names}.
text.fil: Dumating ang mga kamag-anak mula sa sinalakay na {barangay} upang makisilong: {names}.
